name: web_search
description: Search the public web through Nexa's built-in no-key providers. Returns structured candidate results with provider failures; use fetch_url on authoritative result URLs before citing facts. The native router uses Baidu first for Chinese queries and Google first for English queries.

query.description: One focused, natural-language search query. Avoid keyword/operator stacks; use parallel or follow-up calls only for genuinely distinct angles, sites, jurisdictions, time windows, or competing hypotheses.

limit.description: Maximum normalized results to return. Use 10-15 for broad exploration or research scouting, and the default for precise lookups.

region.description: Search routing region. auto chooses mainland_cn for Chinese queries and global otherwise.

language.description: Query language hint. auto detects Chinese text and routes Chinese searches through Baidu first.

engines.description: Optional built-in fallback subset. Usually omit this; configured provider priority from Settings still applies before this list when custom providers are prioritized.

time_range.description: Accepted for forward compatibility; some providers may ignore it.

site.description: Optional single domain constraint such as github.com. The tool turns this into one focused site: query.

include_snippets.description: Whether snippets should be included in the returned candidate results.

provider_profile.description: Provider profile for built-in no-key providers. App settings may also add user-configured Brave, Tavily, AnySearch, SerpAPI, or SearXNG providers as default/fallback.

reranker.description: Optional result reranker. auto infers docs-first, research, or news-balanced from the query and time range.
